definitions.energy: Energy calculated by Fineli (its nutrient factors), published in kJ and converted at 4.184 kJ/kcal
definitions.carbohydrate: Fineli's "carbohydrate, available" (CHOAVL), excluding fibre; Fineli gives carbohydrate by difference separately (CHOCDF). How CHOAVL is derived isn't stated in the archived package documentation
definitions.fibre: Fineli's "fibre, total" (FIBC). Fineli also gives "fibre, total dietary" (FIBT) for most foods, often a different amount; the archived documentation doesn't say how they differ
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol activity equivalents (the US definition; UK and EU targets use retinol equivalents)
definitions.vitaminD: Vitamin D as Fineli gives it (which forms it counts isn't stated in the archived documentation)
definitions.vitaminK: Total vitamin K (phylloquinone and menaquinones); the other tables give phylloquinone only
definitions.niacinNE: Niacin equivalents as published by Fineli
definitions.folate: Total folate, by HPLC (nutrient factors list; not dietary folate equivalents)
